title: Finite filtered-colimit comparison from graded models
statement: Let I be a small directed preordered set [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], possibly empty. Let A:I→Ab, decreasing filtrations F_i on A_i and G on B [def-sp-filtration], filtered transition maps a_f lifting A(f), and compatible filtered cocone maps b_i:(A_i,F_i)→(B,G). Let L,U be common integers such that both F_i^q and G^q are whole for q≤L and zero for q>U. Suppose that for every q there exist a functor Q:I→Ab, isomorphisms e_i:Q_i≅gr^q F_i commuting with the transition graded maps [lem-sp-finite-filtration-induction], and an isomorphism ψ:colim Q→gr^q G with ψ∘ι_i=gr^q(b_i)∘e_i. Then every φ:colim A→B satisfying φ∘ι_i=b_i is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Apply the finite filtered colimit model to obtain H, filtered legs c_i and a filtered descent f with underlying map φ. H is finite. The bounds L and U+1 make G finite. For a given q, take the supplied graded model Q,e and isomorphism ψ. The colimit model supplies the compatible isomorphism θ:colim Q→gr^q H.

proof.text: Prove restriction and gradedMap functoriality by cancelling the target monic filtration inclusion, then the source epimorphic cokernel projection. Check θ followed by gr^q f = ψ on each colimit leg, using the displayed equations and c_i followed by f=b_i. Therefore gr^q f = θ^{-1} followed by ψ is an isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem finite_filtered_colimit_comparison
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (A : I ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (F : ∀ i : I, DecreasingFiltration (A.obj i))
    (B : AddCommGrpCat.{u}) (G : DecreasingFiltration B)
    (a : ∀ {i j : I} (_ : i ⟶ j),
      (⟨A.obj i, F i⟩ : FilteredObject AddCommGrpCat.{u}) ⟶ ⟨A.obj j, F j⟩)
    (ha : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), (a f).hom = A.map f)
    (b : ∀ i : I,
      (⟨A.obj i, F i⟩ : FilteredObject AddCommGrpCat.{u}) ⟶ ⟨B, G⟩)
    (hb : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), A.map f ≫ (b j).hom = (b i).hom)
    (L U : ℤ)
    (hF : ∀ (i : I) (q : ℤ),
      (q ≤ L → (F i).step q = ⊤) ∧ (U < q → (F i).step q = ⊥))
    (hG : ∀ q : ℤ, (q ≤ L → G.step q = ⊤) ∧ (U < q → G.step q = ⊥))
    (hgraded : ∀ q : ℤ, ∃ (Q : I ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u})
      (e : ∀ i : I, Q.obj i ≅ (F i).gradedPiece q),
      (∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
        Q.map f ≫ (e j).hom = (e i).hom ≫ FilteredObject.gradedMap (a f) q) ∧
      ∃ ψ : colimit Q ⟶ G.gradedPiece q,
        (∀ i : I, colimit.ι Q i ≫ ψ = (e i).hom ≫
          FilteredObject.gradedMap (b i) q) ∧ IsIso ψ) :
    ∀ φ : colimit A ⟶ B,
      (∀ i : I, colimit.ι A i ≫ φ = (b i).hom) → IsIso φ
